svg.data-input-ac: 120 V single-phase, 16 A continuous (agency de-rated; for a 20 A circuit), 50/60 Hz
svg.data-capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on, 1.92 kW at 120 V, 16 A in all (spec sheet); it is not what the PDU draws itself, which no document held states
svg.data-output-rating: 16 A total; 16 A max per outlet
svg.data-metering: total output load in amps on the front display; input voltage, frequency and load over the network
svg.data-network-interface: pre-installed WEBCARDLX (PowerAlert Device Manager PADM20), 10/100 Mbps
svg.data-protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, PowerAlert Network Management System, SMTP, SNMPv1, SNMPv2, SNMPv3, Telnet, SSH, FTP, DHCP, NTP
svg.data-product-compliance: RoHS; FCC Part 15 Class A (USA); Trade Agreements Act (TAA)

rect.data-description: the readout window, two seven-segment cells showing the total output load in whole amps; each cell's glyph set is on its digit.

g.data-description: the left digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
the right digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
